vagas.title: Information technology manager
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Information technology manager em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

vagas.title: Senior machine learning engineer
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us. What you'll do Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be successful in this role if you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Regional study director, latam em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others. Position Summary: Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel: You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:Esperamos uma pessoa com olhar apurado, autonomia criativa e vontade real de construir. Alguém que consiga pegar um tema complexo e transformar em uma animação clara. Que saiba equilibrar estética com comunicação. Que entenda quando uma peça precisa ser mais institucional, mais comercial, mais educativa ou mais social-first. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência com monitoramento avançado (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana); Conhecimento em scripts de automação (Python, Bash, Power Shell); Vivência com ECS Fargate e pipelines multiambiente; Experiência em otimização de custos em AWS; Certificações AWS ou Dev Ops. vagas.description:

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others. Position Summary: Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel: You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

vagas.title: Senior machine learning engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Senior machine learning engineer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us. What you'll do Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be successful in this role if you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives, shaping the future of language technology. Note: For this role, you are required to complete the Internal assessment and English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

Empresa está contratando Information technology manager em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

vagas.title: Motion designer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Motion designer em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

LEIA A DESCRIÇÃO! Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28 NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER O time da Pay Conductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes. Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando. Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui. E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro. A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca. Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual. Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES: Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. vagas.title: Full stack engineer
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Full stack engineer em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

vagas.title: Senior python engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Senior python engineer em boa vista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Company: Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Tik Tok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Big Query, Snowflake, and LLMs like Chat GPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more. We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem. Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability. Our Team: Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We're a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React Product: We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API's. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API's and scalability. Technology: We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use: Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint Redis, postgres Linux, docker React, redux for frontend Role Requirements: 4+ years of programming experience. Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.) Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact Fluency in English is mandatory How we work: We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews. Location: Remote Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact. Requirements added by the job poster • Accept a background check • 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market. Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40 MBPS Requirements: Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer: An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Full stack engineer em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

vagas.title: Motion designer
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Motion designer em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

LEIA A DESCRIÇÃO! Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28 NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER O time da Pay Conductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes. Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando. Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui. E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro. A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca. Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual. Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES: Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:Esperamos uma pessoa com olhar apurado, autonomia criativa e vontade real de construir. Alguém que consiga pegar um tema complexo e transformar em uma animação clara. Que saiba equilibrar estética com comunicação. Que entenda quando uma peça precisa ser mais institucional, mais comercial, mais educativa ou mais social-first. Na Pay Conductor, você terá espaço para propor, testar e evoluir a linguagem visual de uma marca que está entrando em uma categoria nova e estratégica para o mercado brasileiro. Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Portuguese language specialist em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Position Overview: As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision. Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs. Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance. Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations. Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots. System Requirements (Mandatory): Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or mac OS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won't be accepted. Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40 MBPS Requirements: Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer: An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

vagas.title: Consultor de vendas b2b
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Consultor de vendas b2b em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sumário do Cargo O profissional será responsável por gerenciar e rentabilizar uma carteira de clientes corporativos (B2 B), além de realizar a prospecção ativa de novas contas. A atuação é prioritariamente interna (baseada no escritório), com a execução de visitas estratégicas e esporádicas para estreitar o relacionamento e consolidar parcerias de longo prazo. Durante os 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência), o colaborador receberá treinamento intensivo e acompanhamento direcionado sobre produtos, processos e metodologias da empresa. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Realizar a gestão consultiva e o desenvolvimento da carteira de clientes B2 B ativa da empresa. Executar prospecção ativa de novos clientes corporativos por canais digitais, telefone e e-mail. Identificar necessidades, qualificar oportunidades e elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e robustas. Conduzir negociações comerciais complexas envolvendo prazos, volumes e margens. Alimentar e gerenciar o fluxo de vendas através de sistemas de gestão internos (CRM / ERP). Realizar visitas externas esporádicas e planejadas para estreitar relacionamento com tomadores de decisão. Garantir o atingimento das metas individuais e o crescimento escalonável de faturamento da sua carteira. Perfil do Candidato & Requisitos Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior em Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins será considerado um diferencial). Experiência Obrigatória: Vivência comprovada em vendas (preferencialmente no mercado B2 B ou vendas complexas). Qualificações Desejáveis: Cursos complementares nas áreas de Técnicas de Vendas, Negociação Estratégica ou Gatilhos Mentais. Competências Técnicas: Domínio e facilidade com sistemas de gestão corporativa (ERP / CRM) e Pacote Office. Competências Comportamentais Críticas: Muita disposição para aprender: abertura total para absorver novos conhecimentos e metodologias nos 3 meses iniciais. Resiliência: maturidade para lidar com objeções, \"nãos\" no processo de prospecção e foco na solução de problemas. Excelente Comunicação Interpessoal: clareza, forte poder de persuasão, postura corporativa e capacidade de se comunicar de forma assertiva com clientes de diferentes perfis. Organização e Disciplina: foco em processos administrativos comerciais e preenchimento preciso do pipeline. Informações Gerais do Cargo Título da Vaga: Consultor de Vendas B2 B Departamento: Comercial Regime: CLT (Efetivo) Remuneração: Salário Fixo + Comissão Escalonável de até 2% Benefícios: Vale Alimentação (VA) + Vale Transporte (VT) Horário de Trabalho: Segunda a Sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h | Sábados, das 08h às 12h Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial (em escritório) com visitas esporádicas para relacionamento externo.

vagas.title: Marketing designer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Marketing designer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side: Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side: The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow What it's like working with them They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

vagas.title: Analista de mis sênior
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Analista de mis sênior em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Por que a Neo Hype? Fazemos parte de um grupo que está redefinindo o futuro do CX e da transformação digital no Brasil. Aqui, você vai atuar com autonomia, impacto real e visibilidade direta na construção do nosso pipeline de crescimento até 2026. Principal Objetivo: O papel do analista de MIS Pleno é usar toda a tecnologia disponível para ajudar a empresa a extrair, refinar elaborando relatórios diferentes fontes (internas e externas). Através destes dados e tendo em conta que o analista deve compreender o contexto em que o negócio opera, pode fornecer ideias para a melhoria dos processos antecipando eventos e desenvolvimentos futuros. O que você vai fazer: · Extração e cruzamento de dados de diferentes fontes e interface com diferentes áreas do cliente; · Responsável por construir relatórios e dashboards (PBI) para acompanhamento de resultados e indicadores operacionais; · Análise e interpretação de resultados, buscando otimizações e inovações diárias com base em soluções analíticas; · Interagir com times para entendimento das jornadas dos clientes, correlacionando aos levantamentos quantitativos e análises; · Atuar como CX na construção de dashboard melhorando a experiência do usuário e resultados da Neobpo. Requisitos · Visão de negócios e comunicação; · Experiência com indicadores; · Capacidade de transmitir conhecimento para os analistas Jr e Plenos. · Capacidade de atuar sem acompanhamento em novos Produtos/Campanhas. Experiência Desejável: 1 ano na função de Analista Pleno. Escolaridade: Ensino Superior Completo ou em curso. Complementar /Cursos Específicos (DESEJÁVEL): Formação na área de Exatas. Competências Técnicas Necessárias (imprescindível): · Experiência como analista, Consultor de BI ou função similar; · Familiaridade com serviços de Call center; · Experiência com tratamento de dados; · Experiência no uso de ferramentas de inteligência de negócios (Microsoft Power BI) e estruturas de processamento de dados; · Excelentes habilidades em estatística e produção de relatórios em PBI; · Conhecimentos avançados em SQL Server (Criação de índices, tratamento de alto volume de dados), PBI, Excel; · Conhecimentos intermediário em Python. Informações adicionais Interessado(a)? Envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro com a gente. #Neo Hype #Tech #Inovação Na Neo Hype, acreditamos que a inovação nasce da diversidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a todas as pessoas, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência (PCD). Valorizamos as diferenças e incentivamos que candidatos de todos os perfis se apliquem. A Neo Hype reserva-se o direito de alterar os requisitos, etapas do processo ou encerrar a vaga conforme as necessidades estratégicas do negócio, sem aviso prévio.

Advogado(a) Associado(a) – Trabalhista (Reclamante) Modelo: Remoto | Contratação PJ | Remuneração: R$ 2.000 Ficha de inscrição: HKU8hpq DVasz3 G8 ATENÇÃO: O Candidato DEVE ter experiência sólida em ações de ACIDENTE DE TRABALHO!!! Residir em Aracaju/SE é diferencial. Você acredita que o Direito do Trabalho é ferramenta de justiça social? Você sente que nasceu para proteger trabalhadores vulneráveis, garantir reparação e enfrentar empresas que violam direitos? Se sim, talvez este seja o lugar certo para você. No Laiza Pimentel Advocacia & Consultoria, nossa missão é clara: defender, com excelência, estratégia e humanidade, cada trabalhador que enfrenta injustiça, adoecimento ocupacional ou acidente de trabalho. Somos movidos por valores que não negociamos: verdade, integridade, proatividade, empatia, firmeza, inovação e coragem para não aceitar a mediocridade. Se isso te representa, continue lendo. O Que Você Vai Fazer Aqui Você será uma peça-chave na defesa de trabalhadores que precisam mais do que um advogado — precisam de alguém que lute por sua dignidade. As responsabilidades incluem: Elaborar petições estratégicas com foco real em impacto para o cliente; Gerenciar sua carteira de processos com autonomia e responsabilidade; Realizar audiências (iniciais, UNA, instrução) e sustentações orais; Atender clientes com empatia, firmeza e clareza; Cumprir prazos com rigor absoluto; Pesquisar jurisprudência, desenvolver teses, inovar; Atuar em procedimentos judiciais e extrajudiciais; Conhecer cálculos trabalhistas (diferencial valioso). Aqui, seu trabalho não é burocrático: é transformador. O Que Oferecemos Você terá a oportunidade de: Crescer em um escritório que valoriza autodesenvolvimento, inovação e pensamento estratégico; Trabalhar com produtos jurídicos full service voltados exclusivamente para o reclamante; Atuar em causas profundas, reais e de forte impacto humano; Participar de um ambiente que une técnica de alto nível com acolhimento e verdade; Ser protagonista da sua evolução, com liberdade e autonomia. Nosso propósito é elevar o padrão da advocacia trabalhista e consolidar uma atuação nacional de referência. Você fará parte disso. Requisitos – O Perfil Que Buscamos Estamos procurando alguém que viva nosso MVV (Missão, Visão e Valores) na prática: OAB ativa e certificado digital; Experiência sólida no contencioso trabalhista para reclamante; Vivência com ações indenizatórias por acidente/doença do trabalho (diferencial valioso); Domínio de cálculos trabalhistas e PJe-Calc; Olhar atento, responsável e organizado para prazos; Capacidade de escrita impecável e argumentação estratégica; Facilidade com tecnologia, IA e novas ferramentas; Excelente comunicação, escuta e senso de justiça; Autonomia, autorresponsabilidade e ética inegociável; Capacidade de trabalhar sozinho e também colaborativamente. Se você é a pessoa que "não aceita a mediocridade", tem coragem para assumir responsabilidades e paixão por proteger gente — você se encaixa. Etapas do Processo Seletivo Ficha de seleção: GFNGnfx5er FBx6 Prova objetiva Prova escrita (peça processual) Entrevista Labor Week – uma semana vivenciando nossa rotina Contratação Se você sente que nasceu para defender quem mais precisa — e quer crescer dentro de uma advocacia que honra o que faz — estamos esperando você.

Technical Sales & Partnerships Manager, NIR - North America Work Location: East Coast (USA) Negotiable Employment Type: CLT/PJ Start Date Availability: Immediate upon approval !!️ Summary of Responsibilities: Manage and develop a sales pipeline across North America. Prospect, qualify, and close opportunities within agribusiness and agro-industrial segments. Sell portable NIR equipment, software, and calibration services. Develop strategic partnerships with laboratories, universities, and research centers. Support the development of a local validation and calibration network for the North American market. Conduct technical assessments, product demonstrations, and validation activities for NIR solutions. Engage with customers to identify needs, applications, and return on investment (ROI). Structure and manage Proofs of Concept (Po Cs) and pilot projects. Implement consultative sales strategies focused on results and technical validation. Gather market intelligence to enhance positioning, ICP, presentations, and commercial processes. Strong skills in proactive prospecting, new business development, and opportunity management. *Ability to build relationships with technical customers, laboratories, researchers, and agribusiness industry leaders. *Interest and ability to learn about NIR, calibration, forage analysis, and feed analysis. *Excellent verbal and written communication skills. *Availability to travel for demonstrations, technical visits, and industry events. *Self-driven profile with the ability to work in a startup environment and handle a high level of responsibility. *Remote position, preferably based on the East Coast of the United States. Preferred Qualifications: *Experience with NIR, FT-NIR, Raman, hyperspectral imaging, portable spectrometers, feed analysis, forage analysis, dairy nutrition, silage, or PAT (Process Analytical Technology). *Existing relationships with forage laboratories, feed laboratories, dairy nutrition consultants, Land-Grant Universities, animal nutrition companies, or agricultural extension groups. *Experience selling through distributors, manufacturers' representatives, laboratories, or technical channel partners. *Ability to conduct basic product demonstrations and coordinate sample testing and analysis workflows. *Portuguese, Spanish, and English language skills.

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Consultor de vendas em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Somos uma empresa orientada a resultados, onde a meritocracia não é apenas um discurso no mural. Construímos um ambiente para quem tem mentalidade de dono e não se contenta com a média. Aqui, o seu crescimento e o seu bolso são consequências diretas da sua produção. A Regra do Jogo (Leia com atenção): NÃO trabalhamos com salário fixo. Nosso modelo é 100% focado em performance. Se você precisa de um salário fixo para se sentir seguro, esta vaga não é para você. Se você confia na sua capacidade de fechar negócios e quer ser muito bem pago por isso, continue lendo. O que oferecemos (Modelo Agressivo de Ganhos): Comissões acima do teto do mercado: Ganhos exponenciais de acordo com a sua esteira de vendas e nível (Júnior, Sênior e Master). Ajuda de Custo por Entrega: Não pagamos para você tentar, investimos quando você entrega. Temos um modelo agressivo de ajuda de custo vinculada à sua produção mensal (incluindo bônus diretos por fechamento/placas de produtos estratégicos, como o nosso Plano Shield). Recorrência: Construa uma carteira sólida e ganhe sobre ela. Zero Teto de Ganhos: Quanto mais você vende, mais a empresa investe em você. O Perfil que Buscamos: Atuação externa \"Hunter\": sangue nos olhos para prospectar e fechar. Autogestão e disciplina operacional (você é dono da sua rotina, mas cobramos números). Resiliência absurda e comunicação objetiva. Histórico comprovado em vendas agressivas. O que não toleramos: Vitimismo, desculpas sobre o mercado e falta de comprometimento. Você tem a atitude e a fome de resultado que exigimos? Candidate-se e venha provar.
