Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros. Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos! Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis. Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial): Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas. vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing designer em palmas. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

AI Marketing Designer Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side: Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side: The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. vagas.title: Especialista em governança de dados
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista em governança de dados em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros. Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos! Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis. Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial): Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas. Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida: PLR/Bônus: Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação! Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família. Vale Refeição: Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! Seguro de Vida: Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos. Extensão da Licença Maternidade: 180 dias para nossas mamães aproveitarem o melhor momento com seu bebê! Extensão da Licença Paternidade: 20 dias para que o pais também possa estar presente nos primeiros dias de vida. Incentivo à prática de atividade física: Acesse o Wellhub (Gympass) e o Total Pass para cuidar da saúde e manter o corpo em movimento. Vale Transporte: Para garantir que seu deslocamento até o trabalho seja tranquilo e sem preocupações. Convênio com o SESC: Desfrute de benefícios incríveis em cultura, lazer, saúde e muito mais! Clube de Descontos: Para aproveitarmos de descontos de até 70% em produtos e serviços com mais de 2.000 parceiros no Brasil e América Latina! Day-off no Aniversário: Para celebrar o seu dia com mais tranquilidade e diversão, você tem direito a um descanso no seu aniversário! Desconto em Farmácias: Descontos exclusivos em medicamentos para você economizar no cuidado com a saúde! Nosso compromisso é proporcionar não só um ambiente de trabalho, mas também uma experiência que valorize e cuide de você como pessoa! Estamos aqui para apoiar o seu crescimento pessoal e profissional. #VEMPROGRUPOCASASBAHIA Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas para candidaturas internas e externas. Pessoas colaboradoras, não deixem de acessar a nossa política de recrutamento interno no Service Now para conferir os requisitos e as premissas do programa.

vagas.title: Marketing designer
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing designer em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

AI Marketing Designer Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side: Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side: The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow What it's like working with them They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

Software Engineer-SMART MODULE Founding smart-module engineer at Quectel's new Manaus hub Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Software Engineer – Smart Module – LATAM Level Mid-Level (3–5 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role Smart modules are where Quectel's cellular tech meets serious compute — Android and Linux platforms with camera, multimedia, and AI capabilities, powering everything from smart POS terminals to AI vision devices and connected industrial equipment. This is a founding-team role at Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll own the smart-module software story for the LATAM region: drivers, peripheral bring-up, multimedia and camera frameworks, and the customer-facing engineering work that turns Quectel modules into shipping products. Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll help define the technical playbook, the customer engagement model, and the way smart-module work happens here. "Smart modules let you touch the whole stack — kernel drivers, camera HAL, all the way up to Android apps. Doing that as part of a founding team, where you shape how things get built? Even better." What You'll Do Own software development and maintenance for assigned LATAM customer projects on Quectel smart modules. Design and develop camera algorithms — image processing, enhancement, optimization. Bring up and integrate camera and image processing features into customer applications. Run camera testing and tuning across lighting conditions to deliver great image quality. Debug peripheral bring-up issues: MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs. Support LATAM customers: develop new SW features, debug their issues, improve the SW stack and demo applications. Collaborate with overseas R&D teams — platform, hardware, FAEs, project managers, QA. Document what you build: design specs, technical analysis reports, knowledge articles. Write clean, scalable, efficient code — and improve the code that's already there. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3–5 years of embedded software experience on Android and/or Linux platforms. Strong C, C++, and Java programming skills. Solid Linux internals and system programming knowledge; RTOS exposure is a plus. Experience with the embedded software development lifecycle. Hands-on experience with Android applications, HAL, and multimedia frameworks (GStreamer, Cam X, Open CV, Open GL). Linux device driver development and peripheral bring-up experience (MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs). Comfort with hardware/software integration and debugging. Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-friendly communication. Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For AI / machine learning experience for image analysis. Familiarity with Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X / Chi-CDK). Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's smart module portfolio — Android, Linux, and Yocto-based platforms supporting cameras, displays, audio, GNSS, Wi-Fi/BT, and 5 G. Read the deep-dive: "What is a smart module? " by a Quectel product manager. Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X/Chi-CDK), GStreamer, Open CV, Open GL, and AI/ML at the edge. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: sasha.saini@ | Browse open roles: Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

Company Description: Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview: As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness. Offer Details: Duration of Contract: 12 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) Key Qualifications: Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

Confira a vaga para Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em boa vista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Company Description: Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview: As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness. Offer Details: Duration of Contract: 12 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) Key Qualifications: Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

vagas.title: Vacation rental revenue manager
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Vacation rental revenue manager em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio. This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week. Compensation: $250 USD per week, paid weekly. What you'll do: - Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends - Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing - Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts - Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability - Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels - Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions You may be a great fit if you: - Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely - Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers - Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills - Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations - Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive - Communicate clearly and can work independently - Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management Nice to have: - Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management - Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting - Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you. To apply, please include: - Your resume - A short note about your relevant experience - Your Linked In profile, if available

vagas.title: Senior python engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Senior python engineer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Company:Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Tik Tok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Big Query, Snowflake, and LLMs like Chat GPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.Our Team:Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with ReactProduct:We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.Technology:We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint Redis, postgres Linux, docker React, redux for frontendRole Requirements:4+ years of programming experience. Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.) Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact Fluency in English is mandatoryHow we work:We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.Location: Remote

You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Full stack engineer em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑nativeinfrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.Key Responsibilities:Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

vagas.title: Lead product designer
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Lead product designer em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Who are we?Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade deNefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas emNefrologia!Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade deNefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.Local de Trabalho: REMOTORemuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.IMPORTANTE:MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

vagas.title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Location:Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration:6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation:Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only:Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery:Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation:Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency:Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese):Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages.You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine:2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility:Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine:You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails:You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential:On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook:Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew:No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination:Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.
